description: Mapped as "TS-5 Bies" but no TS-5 Bies exists; the airframe is a PZL TS-8 Bies and the mapper's designation is treated as an error. Returned to the park after refurbishment; the mapper records 1975 as the year the aircraft was placed there — that is a placement date and is NOT used as year_built. No serial
